name: Paper Collage
blurb: Dusty beige paper desk: B-roll is printed and taped down at angles, every line drops a torn white strip with the key words typed on it, the brand line gets a ransom-note cut-out; on the turn a fresh sheet slides over and the shots stack into a three-photo collage; the turn stamps the brand logo VS the DHgate logo; the title is a brand lockup (brand logo + product + on DHgate logo) on a torn sheet (ransom letters retired 2026-10-22).
